svg.title: Commit calendar for hyyyyyyz
svg.desc: 1,701 public commit contributions from 2025-11-19 through 2026-11-18. A wheeled Franka Panda shuttle collects date tiles and returns them to their original days.
svg.metadata: Panda robot geometry from Franka Robotics via MuJoCo Menagerie, Apache-2.0. Studio renders, shuttle design and animation by Antikythera.
